ctx.x: And a lot of these records that you played on, your name was probably never listed.

Most. I mean most. Hundreds, literally hundreds. And then when they did list them, they would list the name only. And there’s Eric Goldberg is a local musician here who is a fanatic about collecting records. Hundreds of records he has, and he said, “I see your name on so many records” he said, “you were the busiest fourth trumpet player in New York.” There’s a reason for that. Most of the really good players would come in, like say their platform was four chairs for the trumpets, if it’s Doc Severinsen or Bernie…
